sourceText: 我们之前迁移了 ~/work/repo/proof-or-stop-graph 的功能到本仓库，应该是迁移到了源仓库commit 10b5921de4b1fe5b4e796d1a7d78ec655cc400fd的位置，昨天我们在proof-or-stop-graph中又增加了新的功能——story详情页面。请把新增的这些功能全部迁移到我们这个仓库。命令行上应该可以直接打开story详情页面，我记得我们之前的命令是 proof-or-stop graph ，你看看应该怎么加story详情页的命令，按照我们本仓库的惯例来加
normalizedOutcome: All story-detail (dossier) functionality added upstream after commit 10b5921 is present in this repository's packages/graph, and the dossier page can be opened directly from the command line through the existing proof-or-stop graph command, following this repository's established command conventions.
acceptanceClaim: Running proof-or-stop graph --story=<known story id> serves and opens the ported dossier page at http://localhost:<port>/story/<id>, while an unknown id is refused before the server starts listening.
